critique: The slowly retracting Voronoi ceramic scutes, exposing molten video seams beneath an ember-rimmed chevron spine and single pulsing eye, create a bold and convincing fusion of living carapace and machine. The rigidly centered spine and nearly invisible 16-pixel guinea pig feel disconnected from the otherwise cohesive organism; let the glowing fissures branch into and distort the armature, and either enlarge the animal into a meaningful surprise or remove it.
